verses.text: When all the work Solomon did for the LORD's temple was finished, he brought in the things his father David had set apart for God: the silver, the gold, and all the objects. He put them in the treasure rooms of God's temple.

Then Solomon called together in Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes, and the leaders of the families of Israel. They came to bring up the ark of the LORD's covenant from the City of David, which is Zion.
All the men of Israel gathered before the king at the festival in the seventh month.
When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites picked up the ark.
They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy objects in it. The priests, who were Levites, carried them up.
King Solomon and the whole community of Israel gathered with him in front of the ark. They sacrificed so many sheep and cattle that no one could count them.
Then the priests brought the ark of the LORD's covenant to its place in the inner room of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it under the wings of the cherubim.
The cherubim spread their wings over the place where the ark was, and they covered the ark and its carrying poles.
The poles were so long that their ends could be seen from in front of the inner room, but not from outside. They are still there today.
There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets Moses had put in it at Mount Horeb. That was where the LORD made a covenant with the people of Israel after they came out of Egypt.
Then the priests came out of the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had made themselves holy, no matter which group they belonged to.

All the Levites who were singers, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and relatives, stood on the east side of the altar. They were dressed in fine linen and played cymbals, harps, and lyres. With them were one hundred and twenty priests blowing trumpets.

The trumpeters and singers joined together as one voice to praise and thank the LORD. With trumpets, cymbals, and other instruments, they raised their voices and praised the LORD, singing, "He is good; his faithful love lasts forever!" Then a cloud filled the temple, the LORD's house.
The priests could not stay and do their work because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled God's temple.
